name: superpowers
description: Hook-strip fork of superpowers@claude-plugins-official 5.1.0 (MIT, Jesse Vincent — LICENSE alongside). Carries the 9-skill transitive closure that dhx skills invoke by name (/dhx:quick heavy route) or retain for direct invocation: using-git-worktrees, writing-plans, subagent-driven-development, executing-plans, finishing-a-development-branch, requesting-code-review, test-driven-development, verification-before-completion, systematic-debugging. (2026-07-12: receiving-code-review pruned — /dhx:drain inlined its review discipline and no other consumer invoked it. Same day, /dhx:worktree preflight and explain/help debug routing were decoupled from using-git-worktrees and systematic-debugging, but both skills stay — using-git-worktrees is still invoked by the /dhx:quick heavy route above, systematic-debugging as a directly-invocable methodology.) Drops hooks/ (the per-context-window using-superpowers mandate injection, ~1,400 tok) and the 4 skills outside the closure (using-superpowers, brainstorming, dispatching-parallel-agents, writing-skills). Plugin name kept as 'superpowers' so existing superpowers:<skill> references resolve unchanged — do NOT re-enable the official plugin alongside this one (namespace collision).
